# archestra_mcp_registry_entry (Data Source)

Finds an MCP registry entry by its exact name, for example to install one added in the UI with `archestra_mcp_server`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reference a registry entry added in the UI by name.
data "archestra_mcp_registry_entry" "github" {
  name = "GitHub"
}

output "github_registry_entry_id" {
  value = data.archestra_mcp_registry_entry.github.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact name of the registry entry.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Entry description.
- `id` (String) MCP Registry Entry ID.
- `scope` (String) Who the entry is shared with.
- `server_type` (String) How the server runs: `local`, `remote` or `builtin`.
- `tool_prefix` (String) Prefix of the tool names the server's tools get.
